# `emporium.yaml` reference

`emporium.yaml` is the file in a chart that tells Emporium 0.5 what the app needs from the
user, from the cluster and from other apps. It replaces the `@userSupplied` comments and the
integration detection of 0.4. The tables on this page are generated from the JSON Schema
`emporium.build/v1`. `emp chart schema` prints the same schema, and `emp chart lint <chart>` checks a chart
against it and renders it.

::: tip Writing a chart
This page lists every field. For how the fields fit together, how values reach Helm and worked
examples, read the chart author manual (`CHART_AUTHOR_MANUAL.md` in the catalog repository). To convert a
0.4 chart, follow the blueprint [Migrate a chart to `emporium.yaml`](https://github.com/monostream/emporium/blob/main/docs/blueprints/migrate-chart-to-emporium-yaml.md).
:::

Every key is optional except `apiVersion`. A chart also needs `annotations.emporiumVersion: "0.5.0"` in
`Chart.yaml`; without it, or with a lower version, Emporium treats the chart as invalid.
Maps keep their order, which is the order of the install form. A duplicate key is an error.

```yaml
apiVersion: emporium.build/v1
sections: []
inputs: {}
integrations: {}
components: {}
profiles: {}
options: {}
exports: {}
```

## Top level

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiVersion` | `emporium.build/v1` | yes | Must be `emporium.build/v1`. |
| `sections` | list of map | no | List of form sections. Inputs refer to them by `id`. The section `general` always exists. |
| `inputs` | map (keys `^[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*$`) | no | Map of inputs. Declaration order is the form order. |
| `integrations` | map (keys `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$`) | no | Map of integrations by name. The template reads them as `.Emporium.Integrations.<name>`. |
| `components` | map (keys `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$`) | no | Map of components by id. A component makes a workload editable and countable. |
| `profiles` | map (keys `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$`) | no | Preset sizing and settings. `default` names the preselected profile; every other key is a profile. |
| `options` | map | no | Install options. |
| `exports` | map (keys `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$`) | no | Services this app offers to other installed apps. See [App connections](../guides/app-connections). |

## Sections

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (not empty) | yes | Section id that inputs refer to. |
| `label` | string | yes | Heading in the install form. |
| `description` | string | no | Text under the heading. |

## Inputs

An input is a value the user can set in the install form. Fields of one input:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | string | no | Form label. |
| `description` | string | no | Help text under the field. |
| `type` | `string`, `secret`, `integer`, `number`, `boolean`, `enum`, `byteSize`, `duration`, `storageClass`, `cpu`, `memory` | yes | Value type. `secret` values are never returned by the API. `byteSize`, `cpu` and `memory` take quantities such as `1Gi` or `500m`. |
| `default` | any | no | Default value, shown in the form. It must fit the input `type`; for `byteSize`, `cpu` and `memory` it is a quantity. |
| `required` | boolean | no | The form needs a value. Default `false`. |
| `options` | list of string or number or boolean or map (at least 1 item) | no | Choices of an `enum` input: plain values, or `{value, label}`. Required for `enum`. |
| `min` | number or quantity | no | Lower bound. A number, or a quantity for `byteSize`, `cpu` and `memory`. |
| `max` | number or quantity | no | Upper bound, same forms as `min`. |
| `pattern` | string | no | Regular expression a string value must match. |
| `path` | values path | no | Helm values path that receives the value. Omit it when `values.emporium.yaml` reads the value with `input "Key"`. Not allowed together with `ref`. |
| `ref` | map | no | Delivers a `secret` input by reference. Emporium stores the value in the app Secret `<app>-emporium-secrets` and writes the Secret name and key into the chart values. Not allowed together with `path`. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;`namePath` | values path | yes | Values path that receives the Secret name. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;`keyPath` | values path | no | Values path that receives the key name. The key defaults to the input key. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;`key` | secret key name | no | Fixed key name, for charts that insist on one. |
| `section` | string | no | Form section id. Default `general`. |
| `installOnly` | boolean | no | The value cannot change after install (volume claim sizes, topology choices). |
| `growOnly` | boolean | no | The value can only increase (volume sizes). |
| `generate` | map | no | Creates the value once at install and keeps it on every upgrade. Only valid for `type: secret`. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;`length` | integer (min 8; max 256) | no | Length of the generated value. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;`charset` | `alnum`, `hex`, `base64`, `printable` | no | Characters of the generated value. |
| `renamedFrom` | list of string | no | Earlier keys of this input. Emporium carries the stored value over on upgrade. A listed key must not be declared now. |
| `showIf` | map | no | Shows the input only while another input has a value. A hidden input is reset to its default. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;`input` | string | yes | Key of the other input. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;`equals` | any | yes | Value that shows this input. |
| `matrix` | boolean | no | Lint renders the chart with this boolean input set both ways. |

The value reaches Helm in one of two ways: a `path` sets a values key directly, and
`values.emporium.yaml` can read the value with the function `input "Key"`. A `secret` input is stored in the app Secret
`<app>-emporium-secrets`. On update, an empty secret field keeps the stored value.

## Integrations

An integration asks Emporium to provide something. The `type` decides what and which parameters
apply. Parameters of a type sit next to `type`, `required` and `bind`.

```yaml
integrations:
  web:  { type: ingress, skipPaths: ["/api/*"] }
  db:   { type: postgres, database: app, owner: app, version: "17" }
  data: { type: storage, size: { default: 8Gi, growOnly: true } }
```

Fields of every integration:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `ingress`, `oidc`, `smtp`, `storage`, `postgres`, `redis`, `objectStorage`, `app` | yes | Integration type. Each type has its own parameters, listed below. |
| `required` | boolean | no | Whether the app needs the integration. Default `true`. An optional integration adds an `enabled` switch to the install form. |
| `bind` | map (keys `^[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*$`) | no | Sets chart values from integration outputs without a template: output name to values path. The output must exist for the type. Do not bind secret outputs. |

### `ingress`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hosts` | list of string | no | Keys of extra hosts. `registry` gives `<subdomain>-registry.<zone>`, read as `Hosts.registry`. |
| `redirectPaths` | list of string | no | OIDC redirect paths of the app, added on every host. |
| `access` | map | no | Access settings. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;`default` | `public`, `authenticated`, `admins` | no | Who may open the app by default: `public`, `authenticated` (any user) or `admins`. |
| `skipPaths` | list of string | no | Paths that need no login. An exact path, a prefix ending in one `*`, or `regex(<Go regexp>)` without commas. |
| `disableGlass` | boolean | no | Use no login proxy and no OIDC client; the app authenticates users itself. |

### `oidc`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `adminScope` | boolean | no | Ask for the Emporium admin scope. |
| `scopes` | list of string | no | Extra OIDC scopes. |
| `ingress` | string (pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$`) | no | Name of the ingress integration whose client this integration shares. Default: the first ingress integration. |

### `smtp`

Takes no parameters. The user chooses an SMTP configuration at install.

### `storage`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `size` | quantity, or {default, growOnly} | no | Volume size: a quantity, or `{default, growOnly}`. |
| `accessModes` | list of `ReadWriteOnce`, `ReadWriteMany`, `ReadOnlyMany`, `ReadWriteOncePod` | no | Access modes of the claim. Default `ReadWriteOnce`. |
| `storageClass` | map | no | Storage class settings. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;`default` | string | no | Default storage class name. Empty: the provider default or the cluster default. |

### `postgres`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `database` | string (pattern `^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$`) | no | Database name. |
| `owner` | string (pattern `^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$`) | no | Role that owns the database and that the app connects as. |
| `version` | `14`, `15`, `16`, `17`, `18` | no | PostgreSQL major version. |
| `extensions` | list of string | no | Extensions to create at database initialization. List every extension the app needs. |
| `storage` | quantity, or {default, growOnly} | no | Volume size per instance: a quantity, or `{default, growOnly}`. It can only grow. |
| `instances` | integer (min 1; max 5) | no | Number of PostgreSQL instances. |
| `parameters` | map | no | Settings for `postgresql.conf`. |
| `resources` | {requests, limits} | no | CPU and memory for each instance. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;`requests` | map | no | Requested resources. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`cpu` | quantity | no | Requested CPU. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`memory` | quantity | no | Requested memory. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;`limits` | map | no | Resource limits. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`cpu` | quantity | no | CPU limit. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`memory` | quantity | no | Memory limit. |
| `secretKeys` | map (keys `^[-._a-zA-Z0-9]{1,253}$`) | no | Copies keys of the database credentials Secret into the app Secret under the names the chart wants: target name to source key. |

Not available in 0.5: a custom `image`, `sharedPreloadLibraries`, `roles`, `postInitSQL` and
`superuser`.

### `redis`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `persistent`, `cache` | no | `persistent` (append-only file, no eviction) or `cache` (no volume, LRU eviction). Default `persistent`. |
| `size` | quantity | no | Volume size in `persistent` mode. |
| `maxMemory` | quantity | no | Memory limit of the server. |
| `secretKeys` | map (keys `^[-._a-zA-Z0-9]{1,253}$`) | no | Copies provider Secret keys into the app Secret: target name to source key. |

### `objectStorage`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `buckets` | list of string (at least 1 item) | no | Buckets to create. At least one. |
| `size` | quantity | no | Volume size. |
| `secretKeys` | map (keys `^[-._a-zA-Z0-9]{1,253}$`) | no | Copies provider Secret keys into the app Secret: target name to source key. |

### `app`

Connects to another installed app. See [App connections](../guides/app-connections).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `capability` | capability id | yes | The capability the other app must offer, such as `bitcoind-rpc/v1`. Matched by string equality. |
| `permission` | string (pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$`) | no | Permission level to request. The export must list it in `permissions`. |
| `requires` | map (keys `^[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*$`) | no | Conditions on the facts of the chosen producer. A value is compared with the fact; `{sameAs: <name>}` compares with the same fact of an earlier `app` integration of this chart. |

The outputs of each type (`Hostname`, `SecretName`, `PasswordKey`, ...) are listed in the chart
author manual.

## Components

A component makes a workload editable and countable in the install form and in the footprint
preview. Declare one for every workload that matters.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | string | no | Name in the form. |
| `resources` | values path | no | Values path of the container resources map. |
| `replicas` | map | no | Replica rules. Use one form: `path` with optional `min` and `max`; `minPath` and `maxPath` for autoscaled workloads; or `fixed`. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;`path` | values path | no | Values path of the replica count. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;`min` | integer (min 0) | no | Lowest allowed count. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;`max` | integer (min 1) | no | Highest allowed count. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;`minPath` | values path | no | Values path of the autoscaler minimum. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;`maxPath` | values path | no | Values path of the autoscaler maximum. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;`fixed` | integer (min 0) | no | The count cannot change. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;`reason` | string | no | Why the count is fixed, shown to the user. |
| `storage` | any | no | The component's volume size, set by `path` or by an `input`. One of the two. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;`path` | values path | no | Values path of the size. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;`input` | string | no | Key of an input that holds the size. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;`installOnly` | boolean | no | The size cannot change after install. |
| `enabled` | values path | no | Values path (boolean) that turns an optional component off. |
| `parent` | string | no | Id of the parent component. Declares a sidecar container in the parent's pod, sized with the parent. |
| `perNode` | boolean | no | The component is a DaemonSet. Its footprint is multiplied by the number of nodes. |
| `integration` | string | no | Name of the integration that provides this workload, such as the PostgreSQL cluster. |
| `knobs` | list of string | no | Keys of inputs shown next to the component. |
| `needsRWX` | boolean | no | More than one replica needs a ReadWriteMany storage class. |
| `match` | map (at least 1 entry) | no | Overrides how the component is matched to rendered workloads. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;`kind` | string | no | Workload kind. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;`name` | string | no | Workload name. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;`matchLabels` | map | no | Labels the workload must carry. |

## Profiles

A profile is a named preset. `default` selects the preselected profile. Every other key is a profile:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `default` | string | no | Name of the preselected profile. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;`label` | string | no | Name of the profile card. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;`description` | string | no | Text of the profile card. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;`values` | string (pattern `^profiles/[a-z0-9-]+\.ya?ml$`) | yes | Helm values file of the profile, `profiles/<name>.yaml`, relative to the chart root. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;`integrations` | map | no | Parameter overrides per integration name for this profile. |

## Options

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `installTimeout` | string (pattern `^[0-9]+(s\|m\|h)$`) | no | How long an install waits, such as `10m`. Default `10m`. |
| `requiredCRDs` | list of string | no | CRDs that must exist before the install starts. Operators are required, never installed. |

## Exports

An export offers a service of this app to other apps. See [App connections](../guides/app-connections)
for how the pieces work together.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `capability` | capability id | yes | Opaque id of the contract, such as `bitcoind-rpc/v1`. |
| `label` | string | no | Text in the producer picker. |
| `service` | string (not empty) | yes | Template for the name of the Service the chart renders for this export. The host is `<service>.<namespace>.svc`. |
| `ports` | map (at least 1 entry; keys `^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]*$`) | yes | Named ports of that Service. |
| `facts` | map (keys `^[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*$`) | no | Typed facts about the producer that consumers can require. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`type` | `string`, `boolean`, `integer` | yes | Fact type. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`value` | string or boolean or integer | yes | Value, or a template that renders to it. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`immutable` | boolean | no | The fact cannot change while a consumer is connected. |
| `outputs` | map (keys `^[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*$`) | no | Extra string outputs for consumers: name to template. |
| `permissions` | list of string (at least 1 item; unique) | no | Permission levels a consumer may request. The first is the default. |
| `grantsPath` | values path | yes | Values path where Emporium binds the list of connected consumers on every render. It must exist in `values.yaml` as a list with default `[]`. |
| `grantRestarts` | boolean | no | The producer restarts when its consumers change. The panel warns before a consumer is connected or removed. |
| `credentials` | map | no | How consumers authenticate. Default `{kind: none}`. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;`kind` | `none`, `rpcauth`, `exported` | yes | `none`: network access only. `rpcauth`: Emporium creates a user and password per consumer and passes the hash in the grant. `exported`: the chart publishes a Secret and Emporium copies the listed keys to each consumer. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;`secret` | string (not empty) | no | Template for the name of the Secret the chart renders without data. Required for `exported`. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;`keys` | map (at least 1 entry; keys `^[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*$`) | no | Output name to source key in that Secret, or to a map from permission to source key. Required for `exported`. |

Rules the schema cannot express are checked by `emp chart lint`: the `grantsPath` list must exist in
`values.yaml`, the chart must render the Service named by `service` with every port, and a profile or
override must not set `grantsPath`.
